source.description:
PROBLEM
The board-audit package carries two generations without saying so. Gen-1 (ad-hoc bd worktree create per operation, per-PR transport branches board-audit/<id>, PR-checkpoint adapter in client pre-push hooks) is documented in README.md as THE workflow but is operationally dead for checkpoints (market-data PR checkpoints silent since 2026-08-15; root cause: xt end pushes before the PR exists). Gen-2 is live in production since 2026-08-22: permanent orphan worktrees (~/.cache/xtrm/board-audit/export-worktrees/<slug>), one artifact branch per repo (board-audit-export-do-not-cancel), flock-serialized checkpoint with raw-beads.jsonl byte-compare no-op detection, retention keep-3, fanout loop over all mercury repos, fired by systemd user timer board-audit-fanout.timer every 15 min. All 12 mercury repos publish through it. But gen-2 lives in two unheralded scripts and the docs never mention it.

SCOPE — all inside ~/dev/xtrm/packages/board-audit/
1. Rewrite README.md: canonical workflow section FIRST covering board-audit-export-wt (ensure/checkpoint/status semantics incl. no-op signal = byte-compare of raw-beads.jsonl between newest two exports; manifest.json embeds generated_at and must not be compared), board-audit-fanout, the systemd units (board-audit-fanout.service/.timer, PATH Environment gotcha for user units, journalctl --user -u board-audit-fanout.service, cadence knob OnUnitActiveSec), retention keep-3, single-writer fast-forward assumption. Then a LEGACY section clearly marking ad-hoc-worktree handoff/reconcile roundtrip and PR-checkpoint machinery as legacy-but-working.
2. IDEAS.md: mark item 210926 IMPLEMENTED, reference beads xtrm-cv3 (prototype) and xtrm-957 (fanout+timer).
3. Wrapper ./board-audit: add checkpoint|status|ensure|fanout subcommands delegating to board-audit-export-wt / board-audit-fanout so users need one entry point; update its help text.
4. Prepend a short deprecation banner comment to board-audit-pr-adapter.sh and board-audit-pr.py header docstring: PR-checkpoint mode superseded by permanent export surfaces + timer; kept for pr-status verification and existing handoffs. Do NOT delete or otherwise modify logic.

APPROACH
Docs-first revamp; zero functional deletions; verify every command you document actually runs (market-data repo is a safe live target: expect 'no board changes' on clean state).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- README canonical section matches actual script behavior (flags, paths, exit codes verified by running them).
- ./board-audit checkpoint /home/dawid/projects/mercury/market-data exits 0 and prints no-op/pushed line; ./board-audit fanout dry understanding documented.
- bash -n passes on every touched shell script.
- No file deleted; git diff touches only packages/board-audit/.
- Work committed on feature branch, pushed; bead closed with memory ack.

TESTS
tests/ dir exists — add nothing unless trivial; at minimum run existing tests if they still pass after wrapper change, and document result in close reason.

RISKS
Wrapper arg-passing regressions for existing handoff/reconcile users — mitigate by pure delegation (exec) and keeping case arms unchanged.

OUT OF SCOPE
Deleting gen-1 code; changes outside packages/board-audit/; touching the market-data .githooks pre-push block; CI/workflow changes.
